The producer's own R8 remediation (2026-07-20, see run-stateful-additive-migrations-check.ps1's `findings`) deliberately retired these -- their capability moved to the LNCH-1 Postgres Testcontainers twin / StatefulMigrationPlannerTest / Build-NpdevApp.ps1 -PlanOnly, so the script permanently reports them false and gates overallStatus on its `checks` array instead. The schema still required const:true on all of them, so a correctly-passing report was schema-invalid -- the schema was stale, not the report. Fields remain required+typed boolean; only the const-when-passed assertion was scoped down to the 4 that are still real, live-verified signals.
